template.name: One-page brief
template.when: A decision on one page: the ask, the context, the options and a recommendation.

sections.heading: The ask
sections.hint: One or two sentences on the decision wanted and by when.

widgets.markdown: Decide by Friday whether the API tier launches this month or next.

sections.heading: Context
sections.hint: What the reader must know to decide; no more than five points.

items.text: Twelve customers have asked for API access
The pricing page is not written yet

sections.heading: Options
sections.hint: Two to four options side by side with cost and risk.

sections.heading: Recommendation
sections.hint: The option you would pick and the reason in a sentence.

widgets.title: Recommended
widgets.markdown: Launch this month: the customers who asked are ready to pay.
